FULL TEXT:
Notification for Recruitment of Junior Research Fellow
(Project-Based)
Advertise No. BKNMU/ CWCS/ 02-2026 Date: Sept 1, 2026
A walk-in Interviews for the following research positions in various research projects at
Centre of Excellence for Wildlife & Conservation Studies, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta
University, Junagadh, Gujarat, India is scheduled on September 11, 2026 at 11:00 hrs at
the office of the Director, Centre of Excellence. The details of the posts such as
qualifications, experience, fellowships etc are given below:

Job Responsibilities:
 Conduct field surveys, household surveys, GPS-based data collection, ground-
truthing, ecological and biodiversity assessments in the study area.
 Conduct data management, analysis, documentation, and preparation of technical
reports.
 Support in the preparation of final project reports and other documentation.
 Work in coordination with the Project Leaders for smooth project execution.
Interested and eligible candidates may walk in with their CV, Application form (as per the
given format) and all the relevant original documents with photocopy at the following
address.
Date of Walk in Interview: September 11, 2026 | Reporting Time: 10:30 am
Venue: The Office of the Director, CWCS.
Department of Commerce and Management Building,
New Campus, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University, Bilkha Road, Junagadh
For further details, contact to wildlife@bknmu.edu.in
